submission.justification: Absorber-F1 gives the best 100 GeV electron energy resolution among the candidate absorbers in the available Geant4 studies. A scan over the allowed 2--10 mm plate range showed F1 well below the 4.5% hard energy-resolution requirement, with the best averaged result in the refined scan near 4.25 mm (two 100k-event runs at 4.25 mm: 3.266% and 3.151%, average 3.21%; comparable F1 points around 4.5--6.0 mm were also about 3.2%). F3 was consistently worse (best sampled values around 3.6--3.8% near 5.5--6 mm), and F2 did not meet the 4.5% resolution requirement in the sampled range. This recommendation is therefore the best energy-resolution choice from the information available, but it is conditional because the project documents supplied no residual-dose/activation result, so the hard residual-dose requirement cannot be verified from the available evidence.

requirements.requirement: Goal: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Geant4 scan: Absorber-F1 is the best-performing material. Refined F1 scan near the optimum gave 3.266% and 3.151% at 4.25 mm (average 3.21%). Other sampled minima were worse: F3 best sampled about 3.65% at 5.5 mm; F2 best sampled about 4.90% at 5.0 mm and failed the 4.5% requirement.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F1, Absorber-F2, and Absorber-F3; the recommendation selects Absorber-F1.

requirements.requirement: The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: Recommended Absorber-F1 at 4.25 mm produced 3.266% and 3.151% in 100k-event simulations, both better than 4.5%.

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: No supplied project document contains residual-dose or activation data for F1/F2/F3, and the available simulation tool returns only energy resolution. This hard requirement remains unverified.
Recommended plate thickness is 4.25 mm, within the allowed 2--10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F1 with 4.25 mm plates.
